metadata.name: PostInventoryTransactions
metadata.description: The Purpose of this API is to provide the ability to perform the Purchase or Return of Bulk inventory order.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: DecisionFlag
request_fields.description: Flag decides the type of transaction. Valid Values: 0- Sales 1-Return Example: 1 Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account number of cardholder. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:7314145404 Condition:At least one Account identifier input parameter should be passed. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid). Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12345 Condition:At least one Account identifier input parameter should be passed.

request_fields.name: MerchantNumber
request_fields.description: Merchant Number which is assgined to a Merchant, Mandatory If MerchantID not Inputted in API Request Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXX Example: 205136549 Allowable Values: 9

request_fields.name: StoreNumber
request_fields.description: Unique Number which is assigned to a Store. Valid Values:0-9 Example: 205136549 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: RegisterNumber
request_fields.description: Unique Number which is assgined to a register. Valid Values:0-9 Example: 205136549 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Operator
request_fields.description: SpecialMerchantIdentifier as TransactionCode Internal Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SpecialPlans
request_fields.description: ID of  Plan which can be applied for the Transaction. Valid Values:0-9 Example: 1234 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: NonDetailedTxnAmount
request_fields.description: Transaction Amount Ex: 50.02

request_fields.name: InventoryDetails
request_fields.description: Array to capture the purchase/return line item.

request_fields.name: NonDetailedTxnDescription
request_fields.description: User defined description of transaction. Valid Values: A-Z 0-9 Example: TestInventory Condition:If DecisionFlag = 0 then either NonDetailedTxnDescription or InventoryDetails Array details needs to be provided.

request_fields.name: DiscountAmount
request_fields.description: Amount which will deduct from Total Transaction Amount as a discount. Valid Values:0-9 Example:10.00

request_fields.name: TaxAmount
request_fields.description: Purchase Amount for PLAdditional Table if greater than 0

request_fields.name: TotalAmount
request_fields.description: Transaction Amount if source is Sales

request_fields.name: InventoryTranID
request_fields.description: Transaction ID for initiating the Inventory order. Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: ItemCode
request_fields.description: Code of the Inventory line item. Valid Values: 0- 9 Example: 112(Special Orders) Condition:Either of NonDetailTxn Details or Inventory details are required when DecisionFlag=0 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: Description
request_fields.description: Description about Inventory line item. Valid Values: 0- 9, A-Z Example: Order for Firm ABC Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: Quantity
request_fields.description: Quantity of the Inventory Item. Valid Values: 0- 9 Example: 5 Condition:Either of NonDetailTxn Details or Inventory details are required when DecisionFlag=0

request_fields.name: UnitPrice
request_fields.description: Price of the Inventory Item. Valid Values: 0- 9 Example: 50.00 Condition:Either of NonDetailTxn Details or Inventory details are required when DecisionFlag=0

request_fields.name: LineItemTotal
request_fields.description: Price of the Inventory Item. Valid Values: 0- 9 Example: 50.00 Condition:Either of NonDetailTxn Details or Inventory details are required when DecisionFlag=0

request_fields.name: IsMarkDownInAmount
request_fields.description: Flag to decide the discount on Inventory Item. Valid Values: 0-No(Default) 1-Yes Example: 1

request_fields.name: MarkdownAmount
request_fields.description: Discount provided on the total quantity of an inventory item. Valid Values: 0- 9 Example: 5

request_fields.name: MarkdownPercent
request_fields.description: Discount percentage provided on the total quantity of an inventory item. Valid Values: 0- 9 Example: 10

request_fields.name: IsNonTaxable
request_fields.description: Flag decides if the tax should be applied on Transaction or not. Valid Values: 0- No(Default) 1-Yes Example: 1

response_fields.name: PostedPlan
response_fields.description: Name of the Plan with which transaction is initiated. Valid Values:0-9, A-Z Example:RegularPurchasePlan Allowable Values: 50

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: PostedPlan
children.description: Name of the Plan with which transaction is initiated. Valid Values:0-9, A-Z Example:RegularPurchasePlan Allowable Values: 50
